description: This file provides utility functions for managing platform-specific application directories such as data, config, cache, runtime, and standard user directories across different operating systems. It includes functions to retrieve paths for user data, config, cache, logs, documents, downloads, pictures, videos, music, and runtime directories, as well as site-wide equivalents, leveraging platform-specific implementations.
